page.layout: One column of italic letter text, with a bare letter "S." centred above it. Below the text are three centred sign-off lines: "Cl.T.", "devinctiss." and the signature "J. MACCOVIUS.". No margin notes.

l.i: VIr Clariss. Disputationem tuam de Magistratu
Politico adversus Bell. eò diligentius legi, quò videre potui,
quin rem gratiss. feceris iis, qui materiam
Me certè tibi devinctum hoc nomine habes,
& quia nos pudere non debet profiteri,
per quem profecerimus, fateor me tra-
ctatu hoc tuo doctiss. in iis, in quibus
sciebam, edoctum. Deus tibi sufficiat porrò
vires ad bene merendum de Ecclesia Dei.

page.notes: The large initial V of "Vir" is joined to the word. The ligature "ffi" in "sufficiat" is read as sufficiat. Some ink spots and scan specks are ignored. The "Digitized by Google" banner at the lower right is left out.
